waves.rationale: Foundation scaffold: directory structure, pyproject.toml, config, dependencies
Docker + health endpoint (PLAN-1-2) and DB schema + models (PLAN-1-3) are independent once scaffold exists
Auth system (PLAN-1-4) needs models from PLAN-1-3. Must complete before Wave 4.

Admin user management (PLAN-1-5) and VaultRegistry + watcher (PLAN-1-6) need auth middleware from PLAN-1-4. Electron shell (PLAN-1-8) depends on both PLAN-1-1 and PLAN-1-4 — moved from Wave 3 to prevent parallel execution with its own dependency.
Integration tests must run after all code is implemented: auth, admin, vault, RLS
